Team —

Quick heads-up for this week's numbers turnaround. We have a hard submission window on Thursday at 23:59 PT; finance will lock and start consolidation Friday morning. To make that painless, please do the following by the end of Thursday: 

- Update all open opportunities (stage + expected close date + commit reason). Be explicit if this is a "commit" vs "best case."
- Tag any deals with procurement/prod-issues as EXCEPTION and add a one-line blocker.
- Attach the one-pager or deck under the Deal > Files and drop the link in the HS note.
- Run the evidence checklist against each +$50k deal (see checklist).

I scheduled a 30-minute sync Thursday 10:00–10:30 PT to triage last-minute asks and call out any late-stage rollbacks. Please come prepared with: account name, last contact, AM confidence (low/med/high), and any evidence gaps. If you cannot make the call, add your account notes to the shared sheet and flag an owner.

Attachments:
- commit-template.xlsx (fill out commit signal column)
- evidence-pack-checklist.md (minimal required artifacts)

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cForecastFolder
HubSpot ref: HS-1234567

Open asks for ops: can finance-ops@acme.com confirm whether we still accept signed LOIs as evidence for Renewals? (cc'ed)

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Two quick additions from RevOps before lock: 

1) Canary accounts: please include a separate CSV for any accounts that we should exclude from auto-binning or that need manual review (e.g., enterprise procurement cadence). I attached a sample CSV.
2) Evidence variance: for deals with active POs pending, add the PO number to the HS note and mark as "PO-pending" rather than EXCEPTION. That helps downstream matching.

Also — small process note: if you're moving a deal from Best Case -> Commit in the final sweep, add a one-line rationale in the deal timeline (who approved, when). This saves the back-and-forth with finance.

I'm on the sync and will run through the canary list.

—Marissa
